title: Pakistan Institute for Parliamentary Services Amendment Act 2020

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Institute for Parliamentary Services Amendment Act 2020
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIII OF 2020
ACT XIII OF 2020
PAKISTAN INSTITUTE FOR PARLIAMENTARY
SERVICES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act further to amend the Pakistan Institute for
Parliamentary Services Act, 2008
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,
4th March, 2020]
No.
F. 23(171)/2019-Legis, dated 2.3.2020.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent
of the President on the 25th February, 2020 is hereby published for general
information:-
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Pakistan Institute for Parliamentary
Services Act, 2008 (III of 2008) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act shall be called the Pakistan Institute for Parliamentary Services
(Amendment) Act, 2020.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I,

No.
F. 23(171)/2019-Legis, dated 2.3.2020.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent
of the President on the 25th February, 2020 is hereby published for general
information:-
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Pakistan Institute for Parliamentary
Services Act, 2008 (III of 2008) for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment
of section 4, Act III of 2008.---In
the Pakistan Institute for Parliamentary Services Act, 2008 (III of 2008),
section 4, after clause (d), the following new clause (da) shall be inserted,
namely:-
"(da)
to provide for in-service trainings related to parliamentary affairs, to the
Federal Government's officials including the civil servants and such officials
of the Provincial Governments nominated by respective Governments and selected
by the Establishment Division.".
